bloc.Chaque acceptation, personnalisation, re:
Every acceptance, customisation, refusal or withdrawal is timestamped server-side: cookie banner, contact form, sign-up. The IP address is hashed and the user agent truncated (minimisation, art. #).

Procedure. Search by address to retrieve a person’s history. Export the register as CSV to attach it to a reply to the supervisory authority.

Reminder. Under Article #, the burden of proving consent lies with you: this register is your means of evidence.
bloc.Chaque semaine : consulter l'indice et t:
Every week: check the index and deal with anomalies; handle the requests received.
Every month: check the records of processing against changes to the site; check that the automatic purge is running properly.
Every quarter: archive an audit report; export the consent records; review retention periods.
Every year: review the impact assessments; review transfers and their safeguards; update the privacy policy and its version.
bloc.Deux ensembles coexistent. Les modules «: Two sets coexist. The “GDPR compliance” and “Records of processing” modules concern the client’s organisation. The “GDPR — CONSEILPREV” and “AI Act transparency” modules concern our own compliance: public site and Sentinel platform. They are reserved for CONSEILPREV and hidden from clients. In the event of an inspection, only the latter make up your file.
bloc.Effacement. Le compte est anonymisé, les:
Erasure. The account is anonymised, the Enterprise-scope data deleted, and consent records anonymised but kept as evidence. Accounting documents remain (art. #.b). Verify the identity, enter the address, confirm; the operation is logged.

Portability. The export produces a structured, machine-readable file: account, scope, consents. Verify the identity, export, hand over through a secure channel. This mechanism also meets the portability and provider-switching requirement set by the Data Act.
bloc.L'archivage fige l'état de conformité à:
Archiving freezes the compliance status at a given date: full content, index and a hash chained to the previous report.

Procedure. Archive at least every quarter, as well as before and after any significant change to the site. In an inspection, produce the full audit report together with the sealed history: it demonstrates your accountability within the meaning of Article #.
bloc.L'indice agrège les contrôles conformes,: The index aggregates the compliant checks, excluding items that are not applicable. “Refresh compliance” recalculates the rate from the actual state of the database: evidence, withdrawals, expired data, DPIAs, pending requests. The “Real time” box reruns the calculation every thirty seconds while the page is displayed. The anomalies line shows the number of non-compliances detected and the articles concerned. Never let an anomaly persist without treatment or written justification.
bloc.Le rapport d'audit complet, à jour et im:
The full audit report, up to date and printable.
The history of archived and sealed reports.
The records of processing activities, exported.
The consent records, exported.
The purge log, proving that retention periods are actually applied.
The validated impact assessments.
The register of rights requests, with the deadlines met.
The Article # transparency attestation, with the register of AI uses.
bloc.Le tableau recense destinataires, pays e:
The table lists recipients, countries and the applicable safeguard. Providers outside the Union rely on standard contractual clauses or the applicable protection framework.

Procedure. Before adding a provider, check its location and the safeguard invoked, then record it here and in the records.
bloc.Les durées sont désormais appliquées, et:
Retention periods are now applied, no longer merely declared.

Procedure. First run “Simulate the purge”: the expired records are shown without any change; check that the volumes are consistent. Then run “Run the purge”: expired data are anonymised, and the operation is logged and sealed by hash chaining.

The purge log is your evidence of deletion: each entry carries the hash of the previous one, making any alteration detectable.

Automation. A daily scheduled task calls the purge endpoint with the shared secret. Without it, run the purge manually at least every quarter, keeping a record.
bloc.Source unique de CONSEILPREV, stockée en:
CONSEILPREV’s single source, stored in the database and editable here. Each processing activity documents purpose, legal basis, data, retention period and recipients.

Procedure. With every change to the site — new form, new processor, new feature — add or edit the row the same day. Export as JSON for your archives. Records that are not kept up to date are the first weakness found in an inspection.
bloc.Test de seuil sur neuf critères : à part:
Threshold test on nine criteria: from two criteria upwards, a DPIA is required.

Procedure. Tick the criteria. If the threshold is reached, fill in the systematic description, necessity and proportionality, the risks to the rights and freedoms, the measures envisaged, the residual risk and the DPO’s opinion. Save as a draft, then as a validated version once the assessment is finalised.

Point of attention. A high residual risk requires prior consultation of the supervisory authority. Your uses of AI fall under the innovative-use criterion: they call for a DPIA.
bloc.Toute demande est enregistrée avec son é:
Every request is recorded with its one-month deadline.

Procedure. Record it on receipt, specifying the type. Verify the requester’s identity before any action. Use the appropriate tool: erasure (art. #) or structured export (art. #). Finally, mark the request as handled. Overdue requests are flagged and weigh on the index.
